parsed.draft_response:
Hello—thanks for flagging this as a security concern. We’ll treat this ticket as confidential and route it to our security team for human review.

To help us quickly validate whether this is an authorization/isolation issue (and assess whether any data was actually accessed), could you please share the following:
1) Product area/feature: Where are these report links created (exact page/action), and what report type are they?
2) Reproduction details: Steps to observe the cross-workspace/tenant visibility, including who creates the link and who can access it (roles/permissions), and what exactly you see when the other workspace opens it.
3) Link details/constraints: Link format/type (share link vs. generated URL vs. API), whether it requires login, and whether there’s any expiration or permission gating.
4) Evidence of access: Whether any report content was viewed, copied, or downloaded by users in the other workspace/tenant.
5) Scope: Which workspaces/tenants are affected and roughly how many cases.
6) Logs/audit trail: Any relevant audit events, timestamps, request IDs, or system logs you can provide.

Once we have that, our security team can advise on immediate mitigation steps (e.g., whether to disable/limit the relevant link behavior) and the next investigation actions. We’ll also update you as the review progresses.
promised_actions: Escalate the ticket to our security team for human review
Request the minimum additional details needed to validate cross-tenant access and determine whether data was actually accessed
Provide an update on next investigation/mitigation actions as the review progresses
safety_notes: Avoid confirming data exfiltration or root cause based on current information
Request specific reproduction/log details to support security investigation
